chunks: He prayed: 'O Lord, verily my people accuse me of lies.'

key_terms.كَذَّبُونِ: They accused me of lies / They denied

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Hud pray when his people denied his message?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse highlights Prophet Hud's (peace be upon him) transition from public preaching to private supplication after his people's persistent denial, a pattern mirrored by other prophets in the chapter. Shia scholarship often views this as a model for believers facing societal rejection, emphasizing patience (sabr) and reliance on divine vindication (taqdir) rather than immediate worldly success. The verse underscores the theological principle that prophetic success is measured by fidelity to the message, not necessarily by the immediate acceptance of the audience.
